verdict.rationale: DPMA's English application pages explain filing options in plain second-person language rather than bare statute citations. Examples include choosing paper vs. online routes, requesting accelerated examination, the one-year internal-priority window and the 12-month translation deadline. It also offers free initial consultations for inventors. However, the evidence shows option overviews and tool pointers rather than true step-by-step walkthroughs, and the main online filing tool is German-only. missing for 10: explicit step-by-step task walkthroughs, founder-oriented explainers covering the full process end to end, English coverage of the filing tooling, independent corroboration that non-lawyers can follow the guidance.
